title: Frontend / Browser Errors
description: Browser-side JS errors: window.error + window.unhandledrejection spans on service frontend (#1356). These spans bypass the 10% sampler (ErrorAwareSampler, ADR-0033) so counts are true counts; url.path/url.full enrichment shipped 2026-07-04. First draft — refine through usage.

widgets.title: Browser errors over time
widgets.description: Count of window.error + window.unhandledrejection spans per 5-min interval. WITH FILL makes quiet periods read an explicit 0, never "No Data"; a bump means real users are hitting JS crashes — drill into the recent-errors table below.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($start_timestamp_ms) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($end_timestamp_ms) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'frontend' AND name IN ('window.error','window.unhandledrejection') GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($start_timestamp_ms), INTERVAL 300 SECOND) TO toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($end_timestamp_ms), INTERVAL 300 SECOND) STEP INTERVAL 300 SECOND

widgets.title: Errors by page (url.path)
widgets.description: Top 10 pages by browser-error count. "(unknown)" = spans emitted before the 2026-07-04 url.path enrichment, or by stale cached bundles.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT if(attributes_string['url.path'] != '', attributes_string['url.path'], '(unknown)') AS url_path, count() AS errors FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($start_timestamp_ms) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($end_timestamp_ms) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'frontend' AND name IN ('window.error','window.unhandledrejection') GROUP BY url_path ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Errors by exception.type
widgets.description: Top 10 exception types (Error, TypeError, …) across browser-error spans.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT if(attributes_string['exception.type'] != '', attributes_string['exception.type'], '(unknown)') AS exception_type, count() AS errors FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($start_timestamp_ms) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($end_timestamp_ms) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'frontend' AND name IN ('window.error','window.unhandledrejection') GROUP BY exception_type ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Recent errors
widgets.description: Latest 20 browser-error spans: when, which handler (window.error vs window.unhandledrejection), which page, and the first 120 chars of the message. For the full stack, open the span in Traces.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT timestamp AS ts, name AS event, if(attributes_string['url.path'] != '', attributes_string['url.path'], '(unknown)') AS url_path, substring(status_message, 1, 120) AS message FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($start_timestamp_ms) AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli($end_timestamp_ms) AND resource_string_service$$name = 'frontend' AND name IN ('window.error','window.unhandledrejection') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
